S.FORM: masini-a tee=ku pu-Ɂə-Ɂəna pu-a-iisua cau tipari
S.PHON: maʂinia teeku puʔəʔəna puaiisua ʦau tipari
S.FORM: masinia teeku pu'e'ena puaiisua cau tipari
S.PHON: maʂinia teeku puʔeʔena puaiisua ʦau tipa[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: Now I shall tell a story about a giant.

S.FORM: t<um>a-tuturu ma-maraŋə miana, miana.
S.PHON: tumatuturu mamaraŋə miana miana
S.FORM: t<um>atuturu mamarange miana, miana.
S.PHON: tumatutu[r|ɾ]u mama[r|ɾ]aŋe miana miana
S.TRANSL: The elders told (the story) long ago in the past.

S.FORM: kani ia, Ɂuna ta-cini cau cu-culu m-alə-ŋəcai.
S.PHON: kani ia ʔuna tatʂini ʦau ʦuʦuɾu maɾəŋəʦai
S.FORM: kani ia, 'una tacini cau cucuru marengecai.
S.PHON: kani ia ʔuna tatʂini ʦau ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u ma[r|ɾ]eŋeʦai
S.TRANSL: A person was really very tall.

S.FORM: Ɂakia tanasa tu-Ɂuna-in si-a-ʔicəpə.
S.PHON: ʔakia tanasa tuʔunain ʂiaʔiʦəpə
S.FORM: 'akia tanasa tu'unain sia'icepe.
S.PHON: ʔakia tanasa tuʔunain ʂiaʔiʦepe
S.TRANSL: He did not have a house to live in or sleep in.

S.FORM: tee=kirimi maamia Ɂalavaŋ tatia tu-Ɂuna-in ma-ŋucun si-a-ʔicəpə.
S.PHON: teekirimi maamia ʔaɾavaŋ tatia tuʔunain maŋuʦun ʂiaʔiʦəpə
S.FORM: teekirimi maamia 'aravang tatia tu'unain mangucun sia'icepe.
S.PHON: teeki[r|ɾ]imi maamia ʔa[r|ɾ]avaŋ tatia tuʔunain maŋuʦun ʂiaʔiʦepe
S.TRANSL: He would look for a big cave to live in and sleep in by squatting.

S.FORM: nakai ma-ʔanman mu-a-raanə cau mamanai putu-kia-kiau.
S.PHON: nakai maʔanman muaraanə ʦau mamanai putukiakiau
S.FORM: nakai ma'anman muaraane cau mamanai putukiakiau.
S.PHON: nakai maʔanman mua[r|ɾ]aane ʦau mamanai putukiakiau
S.TRANSL: But he liked to help people in the world work.

S.FORM: Ɂuna u-cani taniara, m-i-rəŋəcə Ɂ<um>a-Ɂucanə makai tia=su-raru.
S.PHON: ʔuna uʦani taniara mirəŋəʦə ʔumaʔuʦanə makai tiasuraru
S.FORM: 'una ucani taniara, mirengece '<um>a'ucane makai tiasuraru.
S.PHON: ʔuna uʦani tania[r|ɾ]a mi[r|ɾ]eŋeʦe ʔumaʔuʦane makai tiasu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: One day, there was a heavy rain just like a storm.

S.FORM: ni-m-i-rəŋəcə u-tulu taniara, kaɁanə tara-saŋai.
S.PHON: nimirəŋəʦə utuɾu taniara kaʔanə tarasaŋai
S.FORM: nimirengece uturu taniara, ka'ane tarasangai.
S.PHON: nimi[r|ɾ]eŋeʦe utu[r|ɾ]u tania[r|ɾ]a kaʔane ta[r|ɾ]asaŋai
S.TRANSL: It rained heavily without stopping for three days.

S.FORM: makasua=cu cau mamanai m-i-Ɂaranasə, kaɁanə tavaləɁə pu-aiʔi tanasa.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʦau mamanai miʔaranasə kaʔanə tavaɾəʔə puaiʔi tanasa
S.FORM: makasuacu cau mamanai mi'aranase, ka'ane tavare'e puai'i tanasa.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʦau mamanai miʔa[r|ɾ]anase kaʔane tava[r|ɾ]eʔe puaiʔi tanasa
S.TRANSL: People in the world were troubled by not being able to return home.

S.FORM: vanai si ni-pua-miriɁi ka-vaŋvaŋ cakəran mata nuŋnuŋ, kaɁan=cu tavaləɁə mu-a-siparə.
S.PHON: vanai ʂi nipuamiriʔi kavaŋvaŋ ʦakəran mata nuŋnuŋ kaʔanʦu tavaɾəʔə muaʂiparə
S.FORM: vanai si nipuamiri'i kavangvang cakeran mata nungnung, ka'ancu tavare'e muasipare.
S.PHON: vanai ʂi nipuami[r|ɾ]iʔi kavaŋvaŋ ʦake[r|ɾ]an mata nuŋnuŋ kaʔanʦu tava[r|ɾ]eʔe muaʂipa[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: Because all of the rivers and streams were swollen, they could not get cross them.

S.FORM: mia-sua taku-tavaləɁə sua tipari m-i-Ɂaranasə ka-vaŋvaŋ cau.
S.PHON: miasua takutavaɾəʔə sua tipari miʔaranasə kavaŋvaŋ ʦau
S.FORM: miasua takutavare'e sua tipari mi'aranase kavangvang cau.
S.PHON: miasua takutava[r|ɾ]eʔe sua tipa[r|ɾ]i miʔa[r|ɾ]anase kavaŋvaŋ ʦau
S.TRANSL: The giant got to know all the people's troubles at that time.

S.FORM: t<in-um>mana tipari riaŋ ni-ki-anai sipar-a.
S.PHON: tinummana tipari riaŋ nikianai ʂipara
S.FORM: t<inum>mana tipari riang nikianai sipara.
S.PHON: tinummana tipa[r|ɾ]i [r|ɾ]iaŋ nikianai ʂipa[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: The giant heard the voice (of the people) across (the river).

S.FORM: taku-tavaləɁə tipari Ɂaisi ava sipar-a cau m-i-Ɂaranasə, si kaɁanə tavaləɁə pu-aiʔi tanasa.
S.PHON: takutavaɾəʔə tipari ʔaiʂi ava ʂipara ʦau miʔaranasə ʂi kaʔanə tavaɾəʔə puaiʔi tanasa
S.FORM: takutavare'e tipari 'aisi ava sipara cau mi'aranase, si ka'ane tavare'e puai'i tanasa.
S.PHON: takutava[r|ɾ]eʔe tipa[r|ɾ]i ʔaiʂi ava ʂipa[r|ɾ]a ʦau miʔa[r|ɾ]anase ʂi kaʔane tava[r|ɾ]eʔe puaiʔi tanasa
S.TRANSL: The giant got to know actually that the people across (the river) were in trouble because they could not return home.

S.FORM: mu-caan=cu sua tipari mu-a-sikarə cakəran mari-əpə cau Ɂaisi sipar-a mata-Ɂənal-a cakəran, "tee=kamu u-raan-ən=maku pasu-siparə."
S.PHON: muʦaanʦu sua tipari muaʂikarə ʦakəran mariəpə ʦau ʔaiʂi ʂipara mataʔənaɾa ʦakəran teekamu uraanənmaku pasuʂiparə
S.FORM: mucaancu sua tipari muasikare cakeran mariepe cau 'aisi sipara mata'enara cakeran, "teekamu uraanenmaku pasusipare."
S.PHON: muʦaanʦu sua tipa[r|ɾ]i muaʂika[r|ɾ]e ʦake[r|ɾ]an ma[r|ɾ]iepe ʦau ʔaiʂi ʂipa[r|ɾ]a mataʔena[r|ɾ]a ʦake[r|ɾ]an teekamu u[r|ɾ]aanenmaku pasuʂipa[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: The giant went down to the shore of the river and beckoned the people saying, "I shall help you get across (the river)."

S.FORM: ma-caŋ-caŋarə cau ki-a-cancan mata-Ɂənai cakəran.
S.PHON: maʦaŋʦaŋarə ʦau kiaʦanʦan mataʔənai ʦakəran
S.FORM: macangcangare cau kiacancan mata'enai cakeran.
S.PHON: maʦaŋʦaŋa[r|ɾ]e ʦau kiaʦanʦan mataʔenai ʦake[r|ɾ]an
S.TRANSL: The people were happy to come down together to the river.

S.FORM: makasua=cu tipari kira-vəcəkai na canumu cakəran.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu tipari kiravəʦəkai na ʦanumu ʦakəran
S.FORM: makasuacu tipari kiravecekai na canumu cakeran.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu tipa[r|ɾ]i ki[r|ɾ]aveʦekai na ʦanumu ʦake[r|ɾ]an
S.TRANSL: The giant stood in the middle of the river.

S.FORM: ni-a-rupaca=kiai ramuc-ini ta-cini pasu-siparə.
S.PHON: niarupaʦakiai ramutʂini tatʂini pasuʂiparə
S.FORM: niarupacakiai ramucini tacini pasusipare.
S.PHON: nia[r|ɾ]upaʦakiai [r|ɾ]amutʂini tatʂini pasuʂipa[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: He brought them across (the river) one by one with his hand.

S.FORM: ma-caŋ-caŋarə ka-vaŋvaŋ cau mamanai tee=cu=kita tavaləɁə pu-aiʔi tanasa.
S.PHON: maʦaŋʦaŋarə kavaŋvaŋ ʦau mamanai teeʦukita tavaɾəʔə puaiʔi tanasa
S.FORM: macangcangare kavangvang cau mamanai teecukita tavare'e puai'i tanasa.
S.PHON: maʦaŋʦaŋa[r|ɾ]e kavaŋvaŋ ʦau mamanai teeʦukita tava[r|ɾ]eʔe puaiʔi tanasa
S.TRANSL: The people were all happy that they could return home.

S.FORM: ka-vaŋvaŋ cau mia-sua m-usu-Ɂəəvə ka-vaŋvaŋ na tipari.
S.PHON: kavaŋvaŋ ʦau miasua musuʔəəvə kavaŋvaŋ na tipari
S.FORM: kavangvang cau miasua musu'eeve kavangvang na tipari.
S.PHON: kavaŋvaŋ ʦau miasua musuʔeeve kavaŋvaŋ na tipa[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: All the people thanked the giant (for his help).

S.FORM: p-aranai=cu mia-sua tipari paira=cu mu-a-raanə cau mamanai putu-kia-kiau cu-culu ka-caŋ-caŋarə
S.PHON: paranaiʦu miasua tipari pairaʦu muaraanə ʦau mamanai putukiakiau ʦuʦuɾu kaʦaŋʦaŋarə
S.FORM: paranaicu miasua tipari pairacu muaraane cau mamanai putukiakiau cucuru kacangcangare
S.PHON: pa[r|ɾ]anaiʦu miasua tipa[r|ɾ]i pai[r|ɾ]aʦu mua[r|ɾ]aane ʦau mamanai putukiakiau ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u kaʦaŋʦaŋa[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: The giant often helped the people work ever since, and they were really grateful to him.

S.FORM: ma-kasi cau mamanai na tipari, "ʔapanapa ru-a-vəvə kimia."
S.PHON: makaʂi ʦau mamanai na tipari ʔapanapa ruavəvə kimia
S.FORM: makasi cau mamanai na tipari, "'apanapa ruaveve kimia."
S.PHON: makaʂi ʦau mamanai na tipa[r|ɾ]i ʔapanapa [r|ɾ]uaveve kimia
S.TRANSL: The people said to the giant, "You are invited to visit us occasionally."

S.FORM: kuu=cu mia-ranau ni-vatu tipari ru-a-vəvə na cani piniŋa.
S.PHON: kuuʦu miaranau nivatu tipari ruavəvə na ʦani piniŋa
S.FORM: kuucu miaranau nivatu tipari ruaveve na cani pininga.
S.PHON: kuuʦu mia[r|ɾ]anau nivatu tipa[r|ɾ]i [r|ɾ]uaveve na ʦani piniŋa
S.TRANSL: Before long the giant was invited to visit a certain family.

S.FORM: pa-kari-ini cani piniŋa maraŋə, "ni-ku-caɁania=cu=kara=kasu?"
S.PHON: pakariini ʦani piniŋa maraŋə nikuʦaʔaniaʦukarakasu
S.FORM: pakariini cani pininga marange, "nikuca'aniacukarakasu?"
S.PHON: paka[r|ɾ]iini ʦani piniŋa ma[r|ɾ]aŋe nikuʦaʔaniaʦuka[r|ɾ]akasu
S.TRANSL: An old man in the family asked him, "Have you eaten lunch yet?"

S.FORM: m-ali-vali tipari, "kaɁanə=pa=ku."
S.PHON: maɾivaɾi tipari kaʔanəpaku
S.FORM: marivari tipari, "ka'anepaku."
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i tipa[r|ɾ]i kaʔanepaku
S.TRANSL: The giant replied, "Not yet."

S.FORM: makasua=cu cau cani piniŋa pa-vəra-vəraɁə pu-a-ʔucipi ku-caʔania.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʦau ʦani piniŋa pavəravəraʔə puaʔutʂipi kuʦaʔania
S.FORM: makasuacu cau cani pininga paveravera'e pua'ucipi kuca'ania.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʦau ʦani piniŋa pave[r|ɾ]ave[r|ɾ]aʔe puaʔutʂipi kuʦaʔania
S.TRANSL: The people in the family cooked lunch in a hurry.

S.FORM: ma-curu=cu pu-a-kari na tipari m-usu-taɁatu-a=cu k<um>a-kaənə.
S.PHON: maʦuruʦu puakari na tipari musutaʔatuaʦu kumakaənə
S.FORM: macurucu puakari na tipari musuta'atuacu k<um>akaene.
S.PHON: maʦu[r|ɾ]uʦu puaka[r|ɾ]i na tipa[r|ɾ]i musutaʔatuaʦu kumakaene
S.TRANSL: When food was cooked, they told the giant to serve himself at the table.

S.FORM: cəɁəra-ənə tipari ni-pu-ʔucip-a kaən-a kaɁanə ma-cakuarə, ma-raini k<um>a-kaənə, ni-ku-tiɁiŋi maamia.
S.PHON: ʦəʔəraənə tipari nipuʔutʂipa kaəna kaʔanə maʦakuarə maraini kumakaənə nikutiʔiŋi maamia
S.FORM: ce'eraene tipari nipu'ucipa kaena ka'ane macakuare, maraini k<um>akaene, nikuti'ingi maamia.
S.PHON: ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aene tipa[r|ɾ]i nipuʔutʂipa kaena kaʔane maʦakua[r|ɾ]e ma[r|ɾ]aini kumakaene nikutiʔiŋi maamia
S.TRANSL: The giant found that the cooked food was not abundant, so he ate politely and only a little.

S.FORM: ara-takarə tee=kirimi ta-tupuru-a-in
S.PHON: aratakarə teekirimi tatupuruain
S.FORM: aratakare teekirimi tatupuruain
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]e teeki[r|ɾ]imi tatupu[r|ɾ]uain
S.TRANSL: He got up to look for a seat.

S.FORM: aranai=cu mia-sua mara kaɁanə=cu ru-a-vəvə na cau mamanai.
S.PHON: aranaiʦu miasua mara kaʔanəʦu ruavəvə na ʦau mamanai
S.FORM: aranaicu miasua mara ka'anecu ruaveve na cau mamanai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaiʦu miasua ma[r|ɾ]a kaʔaneʦu [r|ɾ]uaveve na ʦau mamanai
S.TRANSL: Ever since then he did not often visit people as a guest.

S.FORM: tavaləɁə si tia=puaka Ɂinia.
S.PHON: tavaɾəʔə ʂi tiapuaka ʔinia
S.FORM: tavare'e si tiapuaka 'inia.
S.PHON: tava[r|ɾ]eʔe ʂi tiapuaka ʔinia
S.TRANSL: Because he knew that they might dislike him.

S.FORM: ma-kari-kari ka-vaŋvaŋ cau mamanai tee=kita mata-cuvu-cuvuŋu kaən-a pu-Ɂucipi a-pa-kaənə tipari, naka si-a-səʔəvə Ɂinia ni-mu-raanə kitana.
S.PHON: makarikari kavaŋvaŋ ʦau mamanai teekita mataʦuvuʦuvuŋu kaəna puʔutʂipi apakaənə tipari naka ʂiasəʔəvə ʔinia nimuraanə kitana
S.FORM: makarikari kavangvang cau mamanai teekita matacuvucuvungu kaena pu'ucipi apakaene tipari, naka siase'eve 'inia nimuraane kitana.
S.PHON: maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i kavaŋvaŋ ʦau mamanai teekita mataʦuvuʦuvuŋu kaena puʔutʂipi apakaene tipa[r|ɾ]i naka ʂiaseʔeve ʔinia nimu[r|ɾ]aane kitana
S.TRANSL: All the people discussed that they would gather food and cook it for the giant to show their gratitude for his help so far.

S.FORM: aranai=cu mia-sua kaɁanə=cu ru-a-vəvə sua tipari na cau mamanai.
S.PHON: aranaiʦu miasua kaʔanəʦu ruavəvə sua tipari na ʦau mamanai
S.FORM: aranaicu miasua ka'anecu ruaveve sua tipari na cau mamanai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaiʦu miasua kaʔaneʦu [r|ɾ]uaveve sua tipa[r|ɾ]i na ʦau mamanai
S.TRANSL: The giant did not visit the people as a guest ever since.

S.FORM: sua iisi ia, pu-a-iisua cau mata tipari tamna Ɂəna.
S.PHON: sua iiʂi ia puaiisua ʦau mata tipari tamna ʔəna
S.FORM: sua iisi ia, puaiisua cau mata tipari tamna 'ena.
S.PHON: sua iiʂi ia puaiisua ʦau mata tipa[r|ɾ]i tamna ʔena
S.TRANSL: This is the story relating to common people and the giant.

S.FORM: ni-masi-rupaŋə=cu=kita.
S.PHON: nimaʂirupaŋəʦukita
S.FORM: nimasirupangecukita.
S.PHON: nimaʂi[r|ɾ]upaŋeʦukita
S.TRANSL: We are done talking (about the giant).
